Helpful information

Helpful Information

When is delivery free?Delivery is free for orders of $100 CAD or more. Orders under $100 CAD have a $15 CAD delivery fee.
Can I create a custom menu?Yes. Choose dishes from the menu or request a custom quote.
Do you cater large events?Yes. We cater weddings, banquets, corporate events and buffets. Large events receive a custom quote.
How does payment work?Stripe creates a secure checkout page for each order.
